Domestic telephone rates
†*241. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the domestic telephone rate
is higher than the mobile phone rate;
(b) if so, by what percentage and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the percentage of persons using
mobile phones in the country?
Highways linking Tripura with NE
States
*242. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the national highways
in respect of which work has already been
undertaken or is proposed to be undertaken
shortly by the Central Government in the
North-Eastern States;
(b) the names of those highways which
link Tripura with other States in the North
Eastern Region; and
(c) the status of these works,
particularly the highway linking Tripura
and Mizoram?
Procurement of rice from Orissa
*243. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken
steps to procure rice from various States;
(b) the target of procurement set for the
year 2003-04, State-wise; and
(c) the quantum of rice proposed to be
procured from Orissa?
New licence regime
*244. SHRI NILOTPAL BASU: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether by introducing 'unified
licence' Government are migrating to a new
licence regime;

Growth in computer hardware exports
*245. SHRI P ARMESHWAR
KUMAR AGARWALLA: Will the Minister
of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that computer
software services registered a growth of 38
per cent during the first half of the current
financial year;
(b) if so, what is the growth rate of
hardware exports;
(c) what are the targets fixed for the
current financial year; and
(d) whether the targets are likely to be
achieved by the year end at the present
trend?
Foodgrain export policy
*246. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRI VAYALAR RAVI:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are seriously
considering to make export of foodgrains a
"completely market-driven activity" by
facilitating its export by private sector;
(b) if so, the details of the proposal; and
(c) whether Mid-Year Review of
Economy released on November 14 the
need to establish India as a reliable supplier
in global grain market has been indicated; if
so, the steps government are taking to
enunciate stable export policy for
foodgrains?
Troops to Iraq
*247. SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA:
SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE:
Will the Minister of  EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government of the U.S.A. has been
pressurising Government of India to send
troops to Iraq despite the unanimous stand
taken in, and expressed through a resolution
adopted in Parliament;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
(c) whether India has also clarified her
general stand that she stands committed to
encourage peace in the Middle East based
on the right of self-rule by the Iraqis and if
so, the reaction of U.S. Government
thereto; and
(d) whether Government have
announced this in the appropriate forum
of the United Nations and if so, details
thereof?
FCI godowns in Southern States
*248. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of  CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the number of FCI godowns in
southern States, with their storage capacity,
State-wise;
(b) whether these godowns are rodent
and damp proof;
(c) if not, the number of godowns
required to be made rodent and damp proof,
State-wise; and

taken by Government in this regard?

Probes by CBI
1698. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Bureau of Investigation is being assigned
probes both by the Centre and the States,
beyond its capacity;
(b) whether the CBI's prior consent to
accept the probe assignment is normally
sought by the Centre and States; and
(c) whether the CBI is equipped to
handle a large number of cases without
commensurate manpower strength and
upgradation of its investigative skills
demanded by highly sophisticated
economic offences?
Cases lying with CBI
1699. DR. ABRAR AHMED: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state the
number of cases lying with CBI for
investigation during the last five years,
year-wise?

Rural industries in Andhra Pradesh
1700. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether rural clusters have been
identified for developing rural industries
in Andhra Pradesh and other Southern
States under the National Programme on
Rural Industrialization (NPRI);
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise
and district-wise; and
(c) the present status of the projects
under National Programme on Rural
Industrialization, State-wise and
district-wise?
Implementation of PMRY in
Andhra Pradesh
1701. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have evaluated
the implementation and success of Pradhan
Mantri Rozgar Yojana (PMRY) in Andhra
Pradesh and other Southern States;

372

(b) if so, when the evaluation was done
and what were the important findings
thereof, State-wise; and
(c) what action Government have taken
on these findings?
Competition between cottage
industries and multinational
companies
†1702. SHRIMATI SAROJ DUBEY:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that our cottage industries are facing
tough competition with the multinational
companies;
(b) if so, the effective steps Government
have taken to protect the traditional cottage
industries; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Agro and Rural Industries in
Chhattisgarh
1703. SHRI JHUMUK LAL
BHENDIA: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to stat e:
(a) the present status of Agro and Rural
Industries in Chhattisgarh;
(b) whether there are any potentials of
developing new Agro and Rural Industries
in the State;
(c) if so, what are new schemes that
Government are willing to introduce in the
State of Chhattisgarh; and
(d) the effect of introducing  new cash
crops in the State?
Collection of money by Business
Centres
1704. SHRI BALKAVI BAIRAGI: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a large number of Business
Centres in Chandrapur (Maharashtra) are
collecting huge sum from customers for
providing telecommunication services such
as telephones with STD facilities and they
are neither providing such telephones nor
returning the amount collected from the
customers;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether M/s Bhavana Business
Centre, Chandrapur cheated huge sum of
money from residents of Chandrapur
(M.S.); and
(d) if so, whether Government would
take any action against the said Business
Centre and direct them to refund the money
to the customers?
Penalty on Reliance Company
†1705. SHRI KHAN GHUFRAN
ZAHIDI: Wil l the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether orders have been issued by
TRAI against the Reliance Company for
payment of licence fee including penalty
for not obtaining licence for mobile service;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what further ac tion is being taken
against the Reliance?

in Jharkhand have fraudulently withdrawn
money from the saving bank and other

in those post offices;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
